newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ConAgra buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ConAgra buy repeated.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc analysts Ronald Morrow and Elizabeth Downey said Friday they reiterated a buy rating on food company ConAgra Inc. ConAgra on Thursday reported third quarter earnings of $0.63 a share, up from $0.55 a year ago.
-- "Operating across the entire food chain, (ConAgra) continues to effectively offset weak operating areas with strength in other segments," the analysts said in a report.
-- A drop in ConAgra shares on Thursday likely was due to some profit taking, they said. Shares on Thursday closed down 1-7/8 at 54-7/8.
-- Shares on Friday were off 1/4 at 54-5/8.
